name: Rosault
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rosault is a monster of Irish legend. This vast being dwelt in the sea. For reasons unknown it came ashore in County Mayo. Once on land it began to bring up its gut. With every heave it slew more creatures, from plants to sea beasts to human beings. The vomiting went on until the creature used up all strength and died.

attributes.attribute: killed plants, sea life, and humans by vomiting

okr.objective: Rosault is an immense sea monster of Ireland.
key_results: Rosault dwelt in the sea and came ashore in County Mayo.
It vomited, killing the plants around it.
Sea creatures and humans died from its sickness.
The beast died when it could vomit no more.
